Aguanga.name: valerie rogers
Aguanga.text: After attempting to contact other Well companies, these folks responded immediately and pulled the pump out, replacing it and the wiring efficiently and timely. I would recommend them. We were quite concerned with so many wildfires burning and not able to obtain water on the property. Thank you very much for servicing our well.

Alpine.name: George’s Perez
Alpine.text: Came quick answered all my questions!

Alpine.name: Jerry Sanders
Alpine.text:
Service was the same day of my call, The technician was friendly and knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the problem, had me up and running that day, One part was needed to permanently fix the issue.
That part was received and installed the same week.
GREAT SERVICE

Bonsall.name: Mary Ellen Wilson
Bonsall.text: Travis is very knowledgeable and helpful

Deconzo.name: Ashley Cabanas
Deconzo.text:
So happy to have found a reliable pump company. We had an issue where our pump wasn't receiving power after a recent power outage and we did not have water. We called a few companies and southern california well service was the only one who answered. He tried to walk us through it over the phone but we needed a site visit. He was able to get us on his schedule the next day and was very responsive not only with the initial call but also communicating eta, and what he found on site. Our well was back up and running within 20 minutes
Definitely saving this contact and recommending their services to anyone and everyone who needs it! Give them a call you will not be disappointed!!

Thank you again Southern California Well Service. We appreciate you!

El Cajon.name: Currien MacDonald
El Cajon.text: i called late one evening when my pump went out. Their AI answered right away, and actually was surprisingly good. It wasn't a  real emergency, so I left my notes with the AI. Called back by one of the workers first thing in the morning. Took care of everything. Nice!

Escondido.name: kyle yarbrough
Escondido.text: Good guys, went the extra mile to help me get the permit.  The well's been doing great 2 years+ in.

Escondido.name: Denison Golden
Escondido.text: With my 40 years of needing and hiring well service companies, SCWS were by far the most efficient. My pump and 7hp motor were installed in record time at 800 ft. The job needed coordination with my crew to get the rust algae cleaned from the pipes before re-installing and all went by without a hitch. Thank you guys. You're awesome.

Escondido.name: David Bennett
Escondido.text: Brighton's team at SoCal Well is awesome. They've come out same day on almost every occasion we've had an issue, calling back first thing in the morning to let us know we're on the schedule. They replaced pretty much every component of our 30 year old well system over the past 4 years from the pump to the tank. Highly recommend.

Escondido.name: Robert Moore
Escondido.text: Have you used these guys for years!!!  They do a great job very trustworthy.

Escondido.name: Susan Bennett
Escondido.text: They got back to us quickly and took care of the issue we had with our well pump.

Fallbrook.name: Doug Skidmore
Fallbrook.text: The team was very knowledgeable and helpful.  The work they performed was done quickly and efficiently.

Jamul.name: D. L. Imrie
Jamul.text: A rare combination:  They showed up when they said they would; they fully explained what they were going to do before they did it; their prices were reasonable and fair.  They put in 2 new 5000 ga. water tanks and rebuilt 2 wells.  Call them.

Lake Arrowhead.name: Nancy
Lake Arrowhead.text: Kept us informed of the entire process and showed up on time and completed the work with no problems. Great company.

Lake Elsinore.name: Tyler
Lake Elsinore.text: These guys are amazing professionals, who seemed to really care. They provided multiple options for a replacement pump based on my needs and were able to quickly install everything.

Lakeside.name: Joash Sollenberger
Lakeside.text: I’ve worked with a lot of service companies over the years, but Southern California Well Service stands out. My well has been a challenge with one issue after another, yet they handle every problem quickly and with total professionalism. Their responsiveness—whether by phone or text—is unmatched, and their attention to detail gives me peace of mind. Easily a five-star experience.

Lancaster.name: Kevin Wilkes
Lancaster.text: Saving thousand dollars over another estimate. Quick response. Extremely satisfied

Lytle Creek.name: Rosann Flores
Lytle Creek.text: Always prompt and professional. Very friendly, I appreciate it very much.

Moreno Valley.name: Stephanie Johnson
Moreno Valley.text: Life is a lot safer and better with SC Well Service around. What would we do without them?!

Potrero.name: Rosa Lopez
Potrero.text: Quick diagnosis of the issue and quick repair.  Thank you.  Homes with water wells so critical.  Again, thanks for your jock response.

Poway.name: errol ransom
Poway.text: Always reliable. Showed up same day and took care of the issue

Rancho Santa Fe.name: John LaFata
Rancho Santa Fe.text: Superb, honest and efficient service at reasonable price.  What more can you wish.

Rancho Santa Fe.name: John Reveles
Rancho Santa Fe.text: Service was fast and friendly. They were actually able to come out the same day to inspect my well and the prices are fair. Highly recommended.

Rancho Santa Fe.name: john baldwin
Rancho Santa Fe.text:
This has been my go to well service for over 10 years. You will be most impressed by their constant contact and prompt service. They explain things clearly and honor all warranties with no run around. My well had to be pulled after a motor failure and the entire process took less than 3 days with warranty coverage, and small charge to me. The owner, Brighton, even got involved and replaced some items free of charge to assure constant service.
Thank you to all involved.

Rancho Santa Fe.name: alyson coons
Rancho Santa Fe.text: Professional, quality service, and a great “family run” vibe.

San Diego.name: Lippy Lippincott
San Diego.text: I've called on Southern Ca Well Service 3 times now for repairs to my well system.  Brighton is extremely knowledgeable and quick.  I have been impressed with the service every time.  I can't imagine going with anyone else for repair work.

Twin Peaks.name: Carol Bischoff
Twin Peaks.text:
I am writing to share my appreciation for the excellent service we received during our well installation.

While the process took over a year to complete, we now fully understand why. Our project, which was estimated to take three to four days, ultimately required over three weeks due to unpredictable underground conditions. Despite our ground collapsing, your team never gave up and actually drilled the well twice to ensure it was successful.

Having been rejected by two other drilling companies, we are incredibly grateful for your persistence. Your crew was professional, hardworking, and went above and beyond to ensure the well was in perfect working order.

I would highly recommend Southern California Well Service to anyone in need of their expertise. Thank you again for your hard work and dedication.

Best regards,  Bob Bischoff

Valley Center.name: Phoenix
Valley Center.text: Always happy to work with this company. Their work is second to none, I had them redo all the pipes on my pumps, replace booster tanks, and many other things. Last time, we had a broken pipe, they came and fixed it the next day. Congratulations once again on acquiring another well company, it's this kind of company that grows because of their service and workmanship.

Valley Center.name: David Lee
Valley Center.text: Fast reply/response, prompt and friendly service.
